segments.sn45.12:1.3: Namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā”ti.
segments.sn45.12:1.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā nāssudha koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamati, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena.
segments.sn45.12:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā tassa temāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn45.12:2.2: “yena svāhaṃ, bhikkhave, vihārena paṭhamābhisambuddho viharāmi, tassa padesena vihāsiṃ.
segments.sn45.12:2.17: chando ca avūpasanto hoti, vitakko ca avūpasanto hoti, saññā ca avūpasantā hoti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ;
segments.sn45.12:2.18: chando ca vūpasanto hoti, vitakko ca vūpasanto hoti, saññā ca vūpasantā hoti, tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ;
segments.sn45.12:2.19: appattassa pattiyā atthi āyāmaṃ [vāyāmaṃ (sī. syā.)], tasmimpi ṭhāne anuppatte tappaccayāpi vedayitan’”ti.

lines: Tasmā yaṃ sammādiṭṭhipaccayā vedayitaṃ vuttaṃ, tadeva micchādiṭṭhivūpasamapaccayā veditabbaṃ.
Imasmiṃ pana sutte vipākavedanaṃ atidūreti maññamānā na gaṇhantīti vuttaṃ.
Yassa yassa hi vūpasamapaccayāti vuccati, tassa tassa paṭipakkhadhammapaccayāva taṃ taṃ vedayitaṃ adhippetaṃ.
Bhavantare uppajjanto atidūreti maññamāno vipākavedanaṃ na gaṇhātī”ti aṭṭhakathāyaṃ vuttaṃ.

“Iminā nayenā”ti atidisitvāpi tamatthaṃ pākaṭataraṃ kātuṃ “yassa yassā”tiādiṃ vatvā eva sāmaññavasena vuttamatthaṃ pacchimesu tīsu padesu sarūpatova dassetuṃ “chandavūpasamapaccayā”tiādimāha, taṃ suviññeyyameva.
